function_signature: def compute_nicv(traces: np.ndarray, intermediate_values: np.ndarray, num_bins: int = 100) -> np.ndarray
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.95 (17 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: Compute with numpy vectorization; NICV[t] = Var(E[L|V])[t] / Var(L)[t] for every time point t
source: Gierlichs CHES 2008; Standaert-Malkin-Yung EUROCRYPT 2009; the PoI part
author: Liang Jing
